# Soil Moisture Indicators

> An open-source, browser-based library of daily soil moisture indicators for
> environmental and agricultural science: drought indices, plant-available
> water, soil-water dynamics, and long-term trends. It is a static website
> (plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript, no server, no build step). Every indicator has a
> JavaScript implementation used by the dashboard and a published, matching
> Python implementation.

Site: https://soilwater.github.io/soil-moisture-indicators/
Source: https://github.com/soilwater/soil-moisture-indicators (the site lives in `docs/`; paths below are relative to it)

## How the site is organized

- `index.html` — the single-page dashboard. Pick the sample dataset or upload a
  CSV, pick an indicator, adjust parameters, and see charts. Below the result
  chart, a Method card shows each equation on its own line, a definition of
  every variable, the reference, and the Python code (collapsible, with copy
  and download buttons). Uses Plotly.js, KaTeX, and highlight.js (CDN).
- `indicators/<id>.js` — one indicator per file (used by the dashboard).
- `python/<id>.py` — the published Python implementation of the same
  indicator (numpy/pandas/scipy). See `python/README.md`.
- `assets/js/registry.js` — the explicit list of all indicators.
- `assets/js/utils.js` — shared math helpers (quantiles, resampling, seasonal
  day-of-year climatology, peak finding, normal CDF/inverse CDF, run theory,
  Seasonal Kendall).
- `assets/js/app.js` — dashboard controller; `plot.js` — Plotly rendering;
  `csv.js` — CSV parsing and daily aggregation.
- `datasets/sample_daily_data.csv` — bundled sample data.

## Data and time step

All indicators operate on **daily** data. The dashboard aggregates any upload
to a continuous daily series: VWC as the daily mean (days without readings are
missing) and precipitation as the daily total (days without readings count as
0 mm). CSV columns: `timestamp`, `vwc` (m³/m³), optional `precip` (mm).
Profile water storage S (mm) should be divided by the profile depth D (mm)
before use: S/D is the depth-averaged VWC, so all indicators apply unchanged.

## The indicator module contract

```js
export default {
  id: "z_score",                // matches indicators/<id>.js and python/<id>.py
  name: "Z-Score",
  type: "timeseries",           // "timeseries" | "scalar" | "categorical"
  primary: "vwc",               // primary input series ("vwc" or "precip")
  requires: ["vwc"],            // columns needed
  minDays: "any",               // "any" | minimum record length in days
  description: "…",             // what it computes
  context: "…",                 // when/why to use it, for non-experts
  equations: ["z_t = …"],       // LaTeX, one equation per entry/line
  variables: [["z_t", "z-score on day t (standard deviations)"], …],
  reference: "Author (Year)…",  // "N/A" if none; " ; " separates several
  args: [                       // everything AFTER the primary series, in order
    // { kind: "series", column: "timestamp" },
    // { kind: "param", name: "window", label: "…", type: "int", default: 15, min, max, step },
  ],
  compute(primary, ...rest) {}, // pure function of plain arrays
  caption(result, ctx) {},      // optional short HTML line under the chart
  plot(result, ctx) {},         // optional Plotly { traces, layout }
};
```

Python functions follow the same order: primary series first (a daily
`pandas.Series` with a `DatetimeIndex`), then other series, then parameters.

## Indicators

- Soil Moisture Anomaly (`soil_moisture_anomaly`): departure from the seasonal (day-of-year ±w) median.
- Antecedent Precipitation Index (`antecedent_precipitation_index`): daily rainfall total with exponential decay k (uses precip).
- Dry-Spell Duration (`dry_spell_duration`): running number of days below the record median.
- Drought Severity (`drought_severity`): run-theory deficit below the median, in m³/m³·day, for the most severe run.
- Dry-Down Timescale τ (`dry_down_timescale`): median e-folding time of fitted exponential dry-downs; rain ≤ a daily tolerance keeps a dry-down going (uses precip).
- Field Capacity (`field_capacity`): median VWC a drainage time after major wetting peaks (drained upper limit).
- Flash Drought Onset (`flash_drought_onset`): SMPD method on seasonal pentad percentiles (40th → below 20th within 4 pentads).
- Seasonal Mann-Kendall + Sen's slope (`seasonal_mann_kendall`): trend test on monthly means by calendar month, slope in m³/m³ per year.
- Moving Average (`moving_average`): trailing calendar-time mean.
- Relative Saturation (`relative_saturation`): VWC as % of porosity (or of the record maximum).
- Wetting Events (`wetting_events`): rises of at least Δθmin with at least Pmin of rain over w days (uses precip).
- Rate of Change (`rate_of_change`): dθ/dt per day.
- Fraction of Available Water (`fraction_available_water`): (θ − θWP)/(θFC − θWP); also called REW; FAO-56 stress below 1 − p.
- Soil Moisture Deficit Index (`soil_moisture_deficit_index`): weekly SMDI (Narasimhan & Srinivasan 2005), −4 to +4.
- Soil Moisture Memory (`soil_moisture_memory`): 1/e lag of the deseasonalized anomaly autocorrelation.
- Soil Moisture Percentile (`soil_moisture_percentile`): seasonal percentile (Gringorten plotting position).
- Soil Water Deficit Index (`soil_water_deficit_index`): 10(θ − θFC)/(θFC − θWP).
- Soil Water Index (`soil_water_index`): recursive exponential filter (root-zone proxy).
- Standardized Soil Moisture Index (`standardized_soil_moisture_index`): Φ⁻¹ of the seasonal Gringorten probability.
- Drought Category, USDM scale (`usdm_drought_category`): D0–D4 from seasonal percentiles (30/20/10/5/2).
- Wilting Point (`wilting_point`): robust minimum of the record (field lower limit).
- Z-Score (`z_score`): standardized against the whole-record mean and sample standard deviation.
